results.title: Sometimes all you need is a red sky
results.original_title: A veces sólo necesitas ver un cielo rojo
results.overview: A child book’s illustrator goes all the way to South Korea to finish up his next project. However inside every spring-warm street the only thing that comes up to his mind is the girl with whom he thinks shares the same sky.

results.title: Voices Inside Your Head
results.overview: Diverse individuals (a demolition expert, a visagist, a physicist, an Indigenous leader, and a Santo Daime priest) recount how psychedelics transformed their lives in unexpected and profound ways.

results.title: The Ship That Left Without Us
results.original_title: The Ship That Left Without Us
results.overview: After leaving Cairo, a man finds that the lover he could not take with him has never quite left his body. Years later, an ocean lies between them, while the memory of their touch moves through him like a river towards the sea.

results.title: All Is Time
results.overview: The film follows four voters from the same polling station in Rio de Janeiro between 2002 and 2022. Over the course of 20 years and three Lula elections, time transforms their convictions, affections, choices, and the very way they view the world.

results.title: Sweet Bitter Sweet
results.overview: A young Chinese woman relocates to London and works at a bakery while seeking love.

results.title: I'm Not Your Heartthrob
results.overview: A documentary exploring acclaimed Brazilian actor Claudio Marzo’s relationship with fame and his own image as a heartthrob.

results.title: A House of Balloons
results.overview: At her son's graduation, Karin returns to her old home hoping to reconnect. Instead, she's met with coldness and humiliation. As old wounds reopen, the celebration unravels into a tense, intimate fight for dignity and the truth.

results.title: De Tatta's: Daan
results.overview: Daan wants to impress his crush, Layla. He promises to come up with the most epic gift ever for her birthday party. What seems simple turns into a chaotic quest, filled with bizarre situations and unexpected encounters.

results.title: Šipkaři
results.overview: The Darts Players combine black humour, action and a crime plot with a healthy dose of absurdity. Their world is full of characters who have their own agendas, are hiding something and are convinced that they, of all people, have everything under control. The main character, Pepé, believes that this time it will finally work out. All he needs to do is make a few right decisions, find the right people, not panic and, above all, not mess anything up. But his life has never quite gone to plan. When he meets Milánek again after a year, a series of events unfolds that nobody could have foreseen.

results.title: Extázis Uncut
results.overview: An album film for Bongor’s award-winning EXTÁZIS, following the artist’s struggle with addiction. Blending fictional and documentary elements, this genre-defining work is driven by the album’s songs.

results.title: Sternbrücke Forever
results.overview: A declaration of love to an edifice and its people, and a tirade against urban politics. Mehmet sells falafel, Martina has a kiosk and Stefan repairs cars. And every weekend, young people fill the clubs under the Sternbrücke – one of more than a hundred old railway bridges in Hamburg. But its time is up: the plan is to take down the bridge and replace it.

results.title: In Our Panic
results.overview: A grandmother tells her young grandson about a monster covered in white fur — one said to devour children who lie or steal. The frightening tale leaves the boy with lasting trauma. Grown up, the grandson learns of the painful past his grandmother had long kept hidden, deepening his understanding of family and love.

results.title: Fatima
results.overview: Fatima is a model student at her strict school and an obedient daughter to her overprotective father. But in secret, she smokes and trains her voice, developing real singing talent. In a society where singing in public is taboo, she can never let her guard down.

results.title: Chumpa: A Doll Under the Basket
results.original_title: चुम्पा: A Doll Under the Basket
results.overview: Fourteen-year-old Muna wants nothing more than to stay in school, but her dreams are crushed by her village’s rigid tradition of forced early marriage. She turns to her teacher for help, only to be dismissed by the villagers, who ask what use an education could possibly be. In the end, the wedding proceeds, and her dream seems to fade with no way out.

results.title: Cidro Asmoro
results.overview: When a musician's composition achieves unexpected digital virality through a café waitress's unauthorized cover, a commercial strategist orchestrates a collaborative duet between the two artists, igniting an interpersonal conflict driven by their sharply contrasting professional objectives.

results.title: The Things That Vanish
results.overview: In an old house by a remote lake, 81-year-old Sumie lives alone, her memory slowly fading. Michi, the 27-year-old caregiver who comes to look after her, has a slight tendency to steal. Michi feels guilty for not having returned an old wristwatch she found.

results.title: The Soul Whisperer
results.overview: Theresia stays by the bedsides of the dying, praying for them and helping them pass away in peace. At the bedside of Varkichan, a wealthy farmer, she urges him to repent and forgive, but the stubborn Varkichan has no intention of dying this way, nor does he want to show any weakness to his son George and George’s wife, who have returned after ten years and are now waiting for him to die. How can the long suffering and inherited anger that have tormented everyone in the family finally be brought to an end?

results.title: About an Intimate Matter
results.overview: Swarna is a dedicated high school science teacher who relocates to a conservative suburban town with her same-sex partner, Driti. They attempt to build a quiet life together, blending into the community while keeping their relationship private. However, their world is completely upended when one of Swarna's high school students discovers personal, intimate photos of her on social media. The discovery quickly leaks, placing Swarna under intense public and institutional scrutiny.
